claims.claim: Regulators in Paraguay seized a major bank, cutting off savings and pensions for millions.
claims.episode_span: Regulators seized a large bank, cutting off access to savings accounts and pension payments for millions of customers.
claims.source_title: How a bank collapse in Paraguay brought down the country’s President | Explained
claims.supporting_quote: Millions of customers, abruptly, lost access to their savings accounts and pension payments after regulators seized the bank.

claims.claim: The German armed forces reached approximately 190,000 members, the highest level in 13 years, through voluntary recruitment.
claims.episode_span: Defense Minister Boris Pistorius reported that the Bundeswehr now has approximately 190,000 members, the highest number in 13 years, under the current voluntary system.
claims.source_title: Germany news: Frankfurt braces for Iran protests
claims.supporting_quote: Pistorius told newspapers from the Funke media group that the Bundeswehr currently had some 190,000 members, the highest level in 13 years.
